title: Impact of Women's Empowerment Program for Abused Pregnant Women
brief_summary: Although domestic violence is recognized as major threat in pregnancy, there is no intervention has been developed or test to support women in India. To evaluate the effect of women's empowerment program administered to abused women in order to reduce domestic abuse, improving health status and safety behavior.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* at least 18 years of age,
* victims of intimate partner violence, and
* willing to participate

Exclusion Criteria:

* women whose abuser was not their intimate partner or
* who were unable to consent
